text:
jordan: Need help — Acme Tech wants a 6mo POC: API + Optimize + Console add-ons. They proposed a $120k commit and asked for 25% off the bundle. Includes 3 Console seats and ~100k embedding units. Need pricing + deal desk guidance and any security blockers. Need a quote by EOD Fri. @devon-dealdesk @maria-pricing

lena: Quick q — what's the expected token volume and mix (generation vs embeddings)? Also will they be hosted or require private deployment?

jordan: They estimate ~40M generation tokens/mo and ~10M embedding tokens. Prefer hosted but asked about customer-managed keys for logs. Will share SSO and residency reqs shortly.

maria-pricing: 25% is above our standard stack discounts. Typical list for rough math: API gen $0.06/1k, embeddings $0.05/1k, Optimize add-on ~50% of API, Console seats $500/mo. For $120k commit, the usual approved studio is ~20%. We can provisionally do 22% for strategic logos if they take 12mo. For 6mo, cap is 20% unless exec signs off. POC credits should be structured as usage credits, not permanent list changes. Draft pricing lines: 

```
API gen: $0.06 / 1k tokens
Embeddings: $0.05 / 1k tokens
Optimize: $0.03 / 1k tokens (50% of API)
Console: $500 / seat / month
Commit credit: $120,000 applied across services over 6 months
```

If they insist on 25% we need VP Sales + Finance signoff.

devon-dealdesk: We need the SKU-level quote and committed ARR math. Policy: any discount >20% or non-standard bundling requires VP signoff. Suggest structuring as 20% off list + $15k onboarding/POC credit and include 3 free Console seats for 6mo. That effectively gets them closer to 24% without changing our standard ratecard. Also need to capture acceptance criteria for POC in SOW.

samir-eng: FYI — they requested CMK (BYOK) + private routing. If they require CMK with full control or on-prem data residency, that's Redwood Private territory: adds a one-time deployment/ops fee (~$35k) and changes billing. That materially affects the economics — call out in the quote as conditional.

sec-guild: Security checklist: SOC2 report, SAML/Okta SSO, KMS support for BYOK, data residency (eu-west-1), and audit logs. We'll need the completed security questionnaire and sign DPA. If they plan to include PII in prompts we need explicit DPT/processing terms. I'll send our security pack.

jordan: Context: POC will use a masked dataset with minimal PII. They prefer hosted + BYOK if possible. Can hosted + BYOK be accommodated or do we need Private?

lena: Hosted + BYOK is sometimes supported for dedicated tiers, but full CMK control tends to require Private. SE to confirm hosted limits on BYOK and any latency/cost differences.

maria-pricing: Proposed customer-facing quote (for review): 6mo term, $120k commit, 20% standard discount, $15k POC credit applied up-front, 3 Console seats complimentary for duration, Optimize billed at 50% of API list. If they take 12mo we can escalate to 22%. Note: if customer moves to Private, add $35k deployment fee. Final >20% requires VP signoff.

quote-bot: Draft quote Q-2024-511 created for Acme Tech — list total $150,000, proposed net $120,000, discount 20%, includes 3 Console seats, 6mo term.

devon-dealdesk: Provisional approval: 20% + $15k credit + 3 free Console seats for the 6mo POC. Anything >20% or changes to Private deployment requires VP Sales + Finance signoff. Please attach security questionnaire & DPA to the quote before sending.

jordan: Thanks — I'll push the draft numbers into CRM and loop Legal for the DPA. Will update once questionnaire returns. ETA Thu EOD.

samir-eng: Note: if they flip to Private mid-POC expect ~2 weeks reprovisioning + infra fees. Call that out so there are no surprises.

sec-guild: Sent security pack link to the thread: https://internal.docs/security/acme-pkg (placeholder). Please complete and return the questionnaire.

lena: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a usage estimate that maps the 40M gen / 10M embed to line items so Sales can validate the $120k commit math.

jordan: Great — locking here until Legal signs off. Thanks everyone.
